claim_scope: Retrieval metrics and retrieval-risk proxies only; no semantic authorization was performed.

metric_definitions.insufficient_evidence_risk_proxy: Number of queries where no required trusted evidence was retrieved.
metric_definitions.multi_configuration_counts: Strategy-level and strategy-by-top_k groups report raw totals over all observations plus per-configuration means on the common six-query denominator.
metric_definitions.required_evidence_miss_count: Total required evidence IDs not retrieved across the six queries.
metric_definitions.worst_query_ids: Query IDs with the largest required-evidence miss total inside the reported aggregate.
